latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Agent Browser: a fast Rust-based headless browser automation CLI with Node.js fallback.
- Enables navigation, clicking, typing, and page snapshots through structured CLI commands.
- Comprehensive command set for web automation: form filling, UI testing, screenshots, video recording, and data extraction.
- Supports semantic locators, cookies/storage management, network interception, tabs/windows, frames, dialogs, and JavaScript execution.
- Designed for easy scripting and robust automation of web interactions.
